details.name: The Berber Dynasties
details.summary: Tuareg native voices: all 49 recordings, Ages I-IV
details.author: hossein81 and marcokistan
details.description:
Solo native voice test for the current Berber mod.
Tuning Pack: The Berber Dynasties. Game Mode: Berber Civilization. Civilization: Malians.
Install the native audio companion before launching. On the author machine Codex records whether it is installed.
All ages reuse the 49 Age I recordings; missing nonverbal efforts use documented temporary dialogue.
Stock shared nonvoice effects remain; full gameplay audio acceptance is pending.
details.changelog: Retarget only four custom Tuareg EBPS/SBPS variants to proven private speaker tuarg; add native voice manifest/logging.
